name: hbs_support_ticket
query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(st.executive2, 'Unassigned') AS "User:Data:200",

    COUNT(*) AS "Total Tickets:Int:120",

    SUM(CASE
        WHEN st.status = 'NEW' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "New:Int:100",

    SUM(CASE
        WHEN st.status = 'FOLLOWUP' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "Followup:Int:100",

    SUM(CASE
        WHEN st.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "Pending:Int:100",

    SUM(CASE
        WHEN st.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "Completed:Int:100"

FROM `tabsupport_ticket` st

WHERE
    DATE(st.creation) = CURDATE()

    OR (
        DATE(st.creation) < CURDATE()
        AND (
            st.status != 'COMPLETED'

            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `tabsupport_ticket_followup` fh
                WHERE fh.parent = st.name
                  AND fh.status = 'COMPLETED'
                  AND DATE(fh.updated_on) = CURDATE()
            )
        )
    )

GROUP BY st.executive2

ORDER BY st.executive2;

elif status_filter == "All":
